chunks: So turn away from them. When on the Day the crier calls to the painful business,

key_terms.شَىۡءٍ نُّكُرٍ: A painful/unfamiliar matter (referring to the reckoning or reality of the Hereafter)
key_terms.ٱلدَّاعِ: The Crier / Caller (referring to the angel or divine call on Judgment Day)

ai.seo_question: What does the 'painful business' (shay' nukur) refer to in Surah Al-Qamar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-Da'ee' is often identified as the Angel of Death or a specific herald whose call reveals the terrifying reality of the Hereafter, causing the disbelievers to turn away in denial. The term 'shay' nukur' (an unfamiliar/painful matter) underscores the suddenness and severity of the reckoning, contrasting with the believers' anticipation. This verse highlights the psychological state of the arrogant who, despite the clear call, refuse to face the truth of their accountability.
